Hi Samir — thanks for sending this over and welcome. I tried to run the attached PDF through our onboarding OCR pipeline and we have a TIN parsing issue: the OCR captured only 6 of the 9 EIN digits (likely a low-contrast stamp over the form). Before we can move the supplier into the PO system we need one of the following: 

1) A clear typed PDF/scan of the W-8BEN-E with the EIN typed in full (no handwriting or stamps over that field), OR
2) A DocuSign completion of the form so the typed EIN and signer name are captured in metadata, OR
3) A bank letter on bank letterhead confirming the legal name and EIN (bank letter template linked below).

Please let us know which option you prefer. If you go with DocuSign we can send the envelope and that will usually satisfy our KYC team faster. If you prefer to send a typed PDF, please ensure the entity classification box (Part I — line 3) is filled and the signature block includes printed name, title and date.

I’m copying Ben (procurement operations) and Marissa (tax team) so they can weigh in on verification. I’ve attached the OCR extract our system produced for reference.

Attachments: ocr-extract.txt
